units: <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 35:35">Targ. Ex. XXXV, 35</cite> (Y. <cite ref="N00185"><he>נְגַר</he></cite>; h. text <cite ref="H01780"><he>חָרָשׁ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 40:19">Targ. Is. XL, 19</cite>; a. fr.—Y. Sabb. VI, 8ᶜ top <he>מבהתה מימור לנ׳ וכ׳</he> she is ashamed to tell the turner (of ivory), make me another tooth.
B. Bath. 73ᵇ בר נ׳ a young carpenter; a. fr.—נַגַּר טורא [the carpenter of the mountain,] wood-cock.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 11:19">Targ. Lev. XI, 19</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 14:18">Targ. Deut. XIV, 18</cite> (h. text <he>דוכיפת</he>).—
Gitt. 68ᵇ והיינו דמתרגמינן נ׳ ט׳ that is the reason why we translate (תרנגולא ברא) naggar ṭura.—Trnsf. (cmp. חָרָשׁ) artist, master.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 50b:1">Ab. Zar. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>ולית נ׳ ולא בר נ׳ וכ׳</he> and there is no master nor son of master that can solve that; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:2:10">Y. Yeb. VIII, 9ᵇ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 4:6:3">Y. Kidd. IV, 66ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>מילה דנ׳ בר נגרין וכ׳</he> something which no master, son of masters, can solve.—Pl. <he>נַגָּרִין</he>, <he>נַגָּרַיָּא</he>, <he>נִגָּרֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 5:11">Targ. II Sam. V, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 5:14">Targ. Esth. V, 14</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 108a:12">Pes. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>בשוליא דנ׳</he> we mean artisans’ apprentices.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 106a:17">Snh. 106ᵃ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="G00579"><he>זְנֵי</he></cite>. Y. Yeb. l. c.; Y. Kidd. l. c., v. supra.

<cite ref="Beitzah 33b:6">Bets. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>קתתא דנ׳ וחציני</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. <he>נרגי</he>) helves of axes and adzes; <cite ref="Yoma 37b">Yoma 37ᵇ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 8), v. <cite ref="N01257"><he>נַרְגָּא</he></cite>.
